# AWS Single Sign-On Client

The `aws-sdk-sso` package provides a client for making
requests to AWS Single Sign-On.

> **Note:** This SDK is in Developer Preview. Breaking changes may occur prior
> to the release of version 4.0.0.

## Installation

```bash
python -m pip install aws-sdk-sso
```

## Documentation

- [API Reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sdk-for-python/v4/reference/clients/sso/) -
  the SSO client, available operations, and types.
- [Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sdk-for-python/v4/guide/) -
  configuration, authentication, and usage of the AWS SDK for Python v4.
